problem: An ignored stale refresh or unchanged stage could be reported by Admin as a newly saved observation
fix: Serialize prior identity check with the same period advisory lock; return and audit RECORDED/UNCHANGED/SUPERSEDED; display distinct factual Chinese results

coverage: Delayed actual control read suspended before observation; real recognition-evidence source change makes newer read BLOCKED
Older PRECHECK response is SUPERSEDED, retains newer reference and does not create an extra stage row
First actual refresh is RECORDED; same-stage repeat is UNCHANGED
Audit includes disposition and requested source time under same transaction
Admin does not claim a saved new observation when superseded

limits: Controlled suspension schedules actual reader; not universal concurrency certification
True business entry duration, browser journeys and final full recertification remain open
